title: Control Archipelago: musings and evidence hunt
content:
Quick brain dump — treating the controls space like an archipelago: lots of small islands (controls) and a few bridges (procedures/evidence). This is a personal scratchpad — messy, partial, and intended to seed a more formal control mapping doc.

Context:
- We need a fast pass mapping of production access + deployment controls for the external SOC2 run (scope: hosted API + dedicated infra). Focus on: identity/access, deployment review, change control, backups, secrets/KMS, and incident readiness.
- Goal: produce a 2-page control map + a list of candidate evidence files for the assessor by end of next sprint.

Notes to self / high level assumptions:
- Many operational artifacts live in GitHub and S3 buckets; some onboarding/training evidence lives in Google Drive (shared_drives/company).
- We can reuse Dedicated onboarding checklist for some evidence items (config snapshots, capacity policies).
- Avoid over-collecting: prioritize artifacts that show control existence + last 6–12 months usage.

Open questions (need quick answers):
1) Who is the canonical owner for deployment approvals for hosted-api? Product infra or platform-eng? (I suspect platform-eng; ask Ana)
2) Where are the drift-detection logs kept? (CloudWatch vs internal observability?)
3) Do we have a signed retention policy document for backups in the last 12 months?
4) Which service accounts have console access that bypass IAM groups? Need an extraction.

Hypotheses / quick checks to run:
- Hypothesis A: Deployment approvals are recorded as GitHub PR approvals with a protected branch + required checks. Evidence: PR history + branch protection settings.
- Hypothesis B: Secrets are stored in customer KMS + rotation tracked in a spreadsheet. Evidence: KMS audit logs + rotation calendar.

Rough control -> evidence sketch (very rough):
- Logical access (admin accounts): candidate evidence = IAM policy snapshot (JSON export), login review spreadsheet, recent access recertification email, Slack thread about group changes. Owner: platform-engineering. Possible artifact names: iam-policy-export-2026-01.json, access-recert-2025-11.pdf
- Change control (deploy approvals): candidate evidence = GH PRs (PR#s + title list), branch protection screenshot, deployment runbook excerpt. Owner: devops/ci. Artifact examples: pr-merged-list-2026.csv, branch-protection-2026.png
- Secrets management: candidate evidence = KMS audit export, secret rotation ticket list, runbook snippet. Owner: security-infra. Artifacts: kms-audit-jan-2026.log, secrets-rotation-calendar.gsheet
- Backups / restore testing: candidate evidence = snapshot schedule, restore test notes, S3 lifecycle policy. Owner: infra-ops. Artifacts: backup-policy-2025.pdf, restore-test-notes-2026-01.md
- Incident detection & response: candidate evidence = pagerduty playbook, incident postmortem sample, detection rule screenshots. Owner: SRE. Artifacts: incident-postmortem-2025-10.pdf, pdl-playbook-link

Evidence inventory (candidate filenames to fetch):
- iam-policy-export-2026-01.json (probably in infra repo artifacts)
- pr-merged-list-2026.csv (generate via GH API; filter hosted-api repo, last 6 months)
- branch-protection-2026.png (screenshot from github settings — ask Ana or create screenshot)
- kms-audit-jan-2026.log (request from security-infra; may be sensitive)
- backup-policy-2025.pdf (shared_drives/company/misc or infra docs)
- restore-test-notes-2026-01.md (likely in repo: infra/runbooks/restore-tests)
- secrets-rotation-calendar.gsheet (ask Priya for share link)

Quick practical constraints:
- Some artifacts will be redacted for assessor (IPs, user lists). Start with raw export then make a redaction checklist.
- We must avoid pulling cloud logs with full PII — get narrow queries (operation, resource, actor).

Immediate next actions (week 0):
- [ ] Ping Ana in #trust-ops to confirm deployment owner and ask for branch protection screenshot (owner: Ives)
- [ ] Run GH API script to list merged PRs for hosted-api in last 6 months; save as pr-merged-list-2026.csv (owner: Ives)
- [ ] DM Priya to request secrets-rotation-calendar share (owner: Ives)
- [ ] Open TR JIRA ticket TR-4209 to track evidence collection and redaction (owner: Ives)
- [ ] Draft a 1-page control map doc for reviewers using the rough mapping above (owner: Ives)

Risk questions to resolve with owners:
- Are there any emergency-access keys that bypass normal approval flows? If yes, document usage frequency and justification.
- How do we show continuous enforcement (not just one-off configuration)? Need telemetry: deny logs, drift alerts, audit entries.
- For third-party tools (auth provider, monitoring), do we have SBOM or vendor attestation?

Slack / docs refs to check (notes to self):
- Slack search: "deploy approval" channel: #deploys (recent thread with PR gating)
- Confluence: INFRA:Access+Provisioning (likely has policy text) — link: CONFLUENCE:INFRA-ACCESS-PLAYBOOK-82
- GH: hosted-api repo -> protected-branches config -> audit log queries

Redaction & packaging notes:
- Keep original raw export files in a secure internal folder; produce assessor package with redacted copies and a manifest describing redaction rationale.
- Manifest columns: artifact name, original path, redaction type (mask/show subset), owner, creation date.

Loose timeline proposal (for my planning):
- Week 1: collect top 8 evidence artifacts and produce 1-page control map
- Week 2: run redaction pass, create assessor package draft, review with Ana + Priya
- Week 3: hand-off to compliance lead for final submission + Q&A prep

Misc notes / breadcrumbs:
- There's a half-written playbook in shared_drives/company/misc called "deployment-approval-playbook-draft" — check that first before re-creating evidence set.
- Consider using the GH audit log export tool under infra-tools (maybe faster).

Questions for the next sync with Ana (agenda):
1) Confirm owners for each control in the rough map (5 minutes)
2) Priority evidence to fetch (10 minutes)
3) Any existing redaction template we should re-use (5 minutes)

Closing: this is messy and intentionally so. Ives — keep updates here as you fetch artifacts. When enough is gathered, fold into a cleaner confluence draft and mark this doc archived.

---- end of scratchpad ----
